articles.title: BBC confirms complaints after Celebrity Traitors winners Romesh Ranganathan and Sebastian Croft donated to refugees

articles.title: Joint Leaders Statement on Migration at the European Political Community Summit
articles.summary: The UK, Denmark and Italy issue a Joint Statement on Illegal Migration, endorsed by 41 leaders at the European Political Community Summit in Dublin on 12 November 2026.

articles.title: New rules for asylum applications see big decrease in successful claims
articles.summary: Success rate of claims for international protection has been falling for several years anyway, data shows

articles.title: Community exhibition opens at Sligo's Model Arts Centre
articles.summary: A community exhibition featuring the work of more than 100 contributors, including refugees and people with disabilities, will go on display at The Model Arts Centre in Sligo today.

articles.title: A true statesman cannot be a slave to public opinion
articles.summary: By Yun YiA true statesman must withstand the pressure of short-term electoral calculations and push forward with reforms aligned with the nation’s long-term survival.
